CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
November 10, 2020 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Deacon Paul Machuca, Beatitudes of Our Lord Catholic Church
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ROLL CALL
5.
PUBLIC COMMENT
6.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PROCLAMATION FOR SMALL BUSINESS SATURDAY – It is recommended the City Council proclaim November 28, 2020 as Small Business Saturday in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to La Mirada Chamber of Commerce President Rich Trujillo.
6.1 Proclamation for Small Business Saturday
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
REAPPOINTMENT TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council reappoint Lesley Watkins to the La Mirada Community Foundation for a term expiring in May 2021.
7.1 Reappointment to the Foundation
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of October 27, 2020.
8.1 Minutes of 10-27-20
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated November 10, 2020 in the total amount of $1,839,797.92.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-06, VALLEY VIEW AVENUE PAVEMENT REHABILITATION FROM IMPERIAL HIGHWAY TO ROSECRANS AVENUE - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301, Class 1 (c) and will have no significant adverse effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-06, Valley View Avenue Pavement Rehabilitation from Imperial Highway to Rosecrans Avenue; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids when funding becomes available.
8.3 CIP No. 2018-06
8.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2020-05, SPLASH! PUMP ROOM CONTROLS UPGRADE PROJECT PHASE I - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2020-05, Splash! Pump Room Upgrade Project Phase 1 and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
8.4 CIP No. 2020-05
8.5
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE VEHICLES - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of one new heavy duty extended cab chassis work truck with service body in the amount of $39,747.32 and one new heavy duty cab chassis work truck with dump body in the amount of $41,912.84.
8.5 Authorization to Purchase Vehicles
8.6
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING SEPTEMBER 2020 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending September 2020.
8.6 Monthly Treasurer Report
8.7
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING SEPTEMBER 2020 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending September 2020.
8.7 Monthly Investment Report
8.8
AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR POOL COVER REPLACEMENT PROJECT - It is recommended the City Council approve the selection of Lincoln Aquatics to provide pool covers to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
8.8 Award of Contract for Pool Covers
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 20-29 APPROVING A RESOLUTION OF NECESSITY FOR THE ACQUISITION BY EMINENT DOMAIN OF CERTAIN REAL PROPERTY INTERESTS FOR PUBLIC PURPOSES FOR THE VALLEY VIEW AVENUE AND ALONDRA BOULEVARD INTERSECTION IMPROVEMENT PROJECT - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing on the adoption of the proposed Resolution of Necessity, receive from staff the evidence stated and referred to in this Agenda Report ("Report"), take testimony from any person wishing to be heard and consider all evidence to determine whether to adopt proposed Resolution of Necessity, which requires the City Council's separate consideration and determination; find that the public interest, convenience and necessity require the acquisition of the proposed Subject Property for the benefit of the City's intersection and roadway widening Project; find that Project is located in the manner that will be most compatible with the greatest public good and the least private injury; find that the Subject Property sought to be acquired is necessary for the City's intersection and roadway widening Project; find that without the acquisition of the Subject Property, the City will not be able to proceed with the Project; find that the offer required by Section 7267.2 of the Government Code has been made to the owners of record of the property to be acquired; adopt Resolution No. 20-29 approving a Resolution of Necessity declaring certain real property interests located at 15910 Valley View Avenue, and further identified as Assessor's Parcel Number 7001-013-126 ("Subject Property"), necessary for public purposes and authorizing the acquisition thereof, in connection with the Valley View Avenue and Alondra Boulevard Intersection Improvement Project ("Project"); authorize the City's Attorney and City staff to take all necessary steps to deposit with the Court the amount of probable compensation required by law for issuance of the Order for Possession; and authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute all necessary documents.
9.1 Public Hearing - RON 20-29
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
RESOLUTION NO. 20-33 APPROVING THE SUBMISSION OF AN APPLICATION FOR GRANT FUNDS FOR THE CALIFORNIA DROUGHT, WATER, PARKS, CLIMATE, COASTAL PROTECTION, AND OUTDOOR ACCESS FOR ALL ACT OF 2018 (PROPOSITION 68) FOR THE LA MIRADA CREEK PARK RENOVATION PROJECT – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-33 approving the City's submission of an application for grant funds for the RMC Proposition 68 Grant Program for the La Mirada Creek Park Renovation Project and authorizing the City Manager to sign all grant documents.
10.1 Resolution No. 20-33
10.2
RESOLUTION NO. 20-34 WAIVING THE FORMAL BID PROCESS AND AUTHORIZING THE PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF EMERGENCY LIGHTING SYSTEM REPLACEMENT COMPONENTS AND BATTERIES FOR SPLASH! LA MIRADA REGIONAL AQUATICS CENTER - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-34 waiving the formal bid process and authorizing the purchase and installation of emergency lighting system replacement components and batteries and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract with Emergency Lighting Equipment Service Company, Inc. at a cost not to exceed $37,409.38.
10.2 Resolution No. 20-34
